chunks: Then We shall bring Hell right before the infidels
ai.seo_question: What happens to Hell on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'عرضاً' (presentation) implies a comprehensive and vivid display of Hell's reality, serving as a direct consequence for those who followed the path of the disbelievers mentioned earlier in Surah Al-Kahf. This verse underscores the tangible nature of the Hereafter, reinforcing the concept of divine justice where the fate of the disbelievers is made manifest before their eyes. It serves as a spiritual warning, linking the historical narrative of the Cave to the ultimate eschatological reality.
